verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents API credentials with ECDSA request signing, an IP allowlist per credential, transfer creation, and Web Banking approval flows. None of this is an agent-scoped credential that enforces transfer amount caps or counterparty allowlists, and the evidence never names agent use. The IP allowlist and card spending limits are adjacent controls, not the policy-bounded agent access the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
